entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hello, Isaac. I'm calling about my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I'd like to start a return for it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you provide me with the order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

Thank you. I'm pulling up your account now... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 15th. Before we proceed, could you tell me a bit more about the reason for the return? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, no, it works fine. To be honest, I just changed my mind. It was a bit of an impulse buy, and after a month, I realize I just don't use it as much as I thought I would.
I understand. Sometimes a device just doesn't fit into our routine the way we expect.

Exactly. Now, I know it's been 31 days, and some companies have strict 30-day rules. I was hoping we could work something out. I'd be willing to take store credit or even a partial refund. I'd rather do that than go through the trouble of a private resale online.
I appreciate you explaining that. Let me just pull up the official return policy for your item to be certain... One moment.

Okay, I've got it here. Actually, you have nothing to worry about. The VeloBand GPS Tracker falls under our 10-day return policy. Since you received it 31 days ago, you're unfortunately outside the timeframe for a full refund.
Oh, really? Ninety days? That's fantastic! I was all prepared to negotiate.

No negotiation needed today. I've gone ahead and authorized the return in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions on how to send the band back to us. Once we receive it, the full refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Wow, that was much easier than I expected. Thank you so much for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
